title: This repo runs on its own plugin

statements.says: The skills move out of .claude/skills/ and into the plugin under plugins/.
This repo loads the plugin the way any other repo would: its .claude/settings.json names the marketplace in plugins/ and enables the plugin.
Every skill that names another by its bare name changes to the namespaced form, such as /skillworks:spec-loop rather than /spec-loop.
There is one copy of each skill.
Every session in this repo proves the plugin loads and works.

Copying the skills into the plugin was rejected, because .claude/skills/ would stay the working copy, the plugin would drift from it, and nothing in this repo would ever load the copy other repos receive.
